author: Blyth, 1842
status: 나그네새, 해마다 10만 마리 이상 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록
summary: 봄과 가을에 해마다 10만 마리 이상이 한반도를 지나가는 흔한 나그네새로, 산지 숲에서 주로 홀로 지내며 곤충을 주로 잡아먹는다. 숲속 땅 위나 관목의 낮은 가지에 둥지를 짓고, 6월 중순~7월 중순에 한배에 5~7개의 알을 낳는다. 시베리아, 바이칼호, 아무르, 몽골 북부, 만주, 우수리에서 번식하고 중국 남부와 말레이시아로 내려가 겨울을 난다.

points.en: thin, weak olive or greyish-brown legs

art.subject: Yellow-browed Warbler (Phylloscopus inornatus), adult (sexes alike) on spring or autumn passage: upperparts greyish olive-green, the rump the same colour as the back; a long, broad, pale yellowish supercilium from the bill to the rear of the head; a dark olive eye-stripe; two whitish-yellow wing bars, the one on the greater coverts long and bold, the upper one short; dark tertials with clean whitish edges; underparts whitish with a faint yellowish wash on the breast sides; thin dark bill with a pale yellowish base to the lower mandible; dark eye; thin pale brownish legs.
art.pose: perched on a low shrub branch, side view
art.scene: Korean mountain forest with a shrubby understorey in spring or autumn; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a twig: long yellowish supercilium, dark eye-stripe, greyish olive-green upperparts, bold whitish greater-covert wing bar and a shorter upper bar, pale-edged tertials, whitish underparts, pale legs

adult, side view perched, seen slightly from above, head facing forward: olive-green crown with no pale central stripe, both wing bars and the pale tertial edges clearly visible, rump olive like the back
art.build: Tiny, slim leaf warbler, about 10cm: much smaller than a sparrow, about the size of a Coal Tit but slimmer. Small rounded head, no crest. Bill very thin and short, straight and pointed, much shorter than the head. Legs thin and weak, pale brownish. At rest the wingtips reach the base of the tail. Tail short to medium, square-ended. Restless, flicking its wings while picking insects from leaves.
avoid: Do not paint a pale central crown stripe or a lemon-yellow rump patch; those mark Pallas's Leaf Warbler.
Do not paint bright yellow underparts; the underparts are whitish.
Do not paint only one faint wing bar; that suggests Arctic or Greenish Warbler.
Do not paint a thick bill or dark heavy legs.
